verdict.rationale: Fivetran supports scheduling transformations after connector syncs (fivetran-docs-37) and orchestrating dbt/Coalesce transformations (fivetran-docs-5, fivetran-docs-25), which provides some dependency-based ordering between ingestion and transformation steps. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose DAG or cross-pipeline dependency definition system (like Airflow-style task dependencies) for orchestrating arbitrary pipeline steps beyond sync-then-transform. missing for 10: explicit dependency graph/DAG definition across multiple connectors and datasets, cross-pipeline conditional triggers, hands-on evidence of complex multi-step orchestration working reliably.
